title: Rav Ada bar Minyomi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Ravina’s student, as in Bava Kamma 31b, where he explained the teaching before Ravina; in Chullin 5a he raised a difficulty against Ravina; and there at 48b, regarding a needle found in the large duct of the liver, Huna Mar son of Rav Idi declared it terefah and Rav Ada bar Minyomi declared it kosher. They came and asked Ravina, who ruled like Rav Ada bar Minyomi. He was a judge in Nehardea, as stated explicitly in Sanhedrin 17b.

notes.text: The liver’s סמפונא is rendered a duct, not a bronchus. The supplied Chullin 48b remains alongside the saved Davidson 49a needle case. No fresh claim about other Hyman entries is needed for that comparison.
